per_source_refresh_rule.crossref_rest_api: refresh by DOI/update timestamp or pinned data-file snapshot
per_source_refresh_rule.open_library_api: pin API retrieval or dump snapshot and replace source-native records on the next snapshot
per_source_refresh_rule.openalex_api: pin quarterly snapshot or retrieval date; apply source-native updated-date replacement
per_source_refresh_rule.openreview_api: refresh by note/profile ID and modification time; keep revision lineage
per_source_refresh_rule.podcast_index_api: API material is cache-header bounded; refresh only within current API terms
per_source_refresh_rule.podcast_rss: honour Cache-Control, ETag, Last-Modified, Retry-After, and publisher cadence
per_source_refresh_rule.pretalx_schedule: pin schedule version; replace from latest published schedule only when deliberately requested
per_source_refresh_rule.public_web_schema_org: re-fetch only under page terms and robots policy; content hash every supplied page
per_source_refresh_rule.youtube_data_api: refresh or delete stored API data within 30 days unless a current documented exception applies

freshness.podcast_index: cache-header bounded; prefer publisher RSS for durable replay

source_constraints.crossref_rest_api: use the polite pool/mailto, cache, back off, and obey current response headers
source_constraints.open_library_api: bounded API use: identify the client; use current published limits; prefer dumps for bulk
source_constraints.openalex_api: API key and metered daily credits; use snapshots for reproducible bulk work
source_constraints.openreview_api: bounded API use with current server limits and backoff
source_constraints.podcast_index_api: credentialed access; obey response cache/rate headers and current API documentation
source_constraints.podcast_rss: publisher-specific; use conditional GET and an identified user agent
source_constraints.pretalx_schedule: event-instance specific; use public endpoints only and back off
source_constraints.public_web_schema_org: site-specific robots/rate policy; no authentication bypass
source_constraints.youtube_data_api: project quota units and endpoint-specific costs; no quota circumvention
